source_snapshot.script: No bundle; 30 attended and 180 machine minutes; unique row/variant.
source_snapshot.deepseek: PARTIAL; requires NVIDIA LTSSM/NVQual and operator setup with per-iteration link/error output.

old_problem: A tool can remain at Gen5 or downtrain while still yielding a clean final snapshot. Without a proven Gen3 start and transaction-level training evidence, it would not exercise the distinct Speed Change 35 coverage.
disposition_reason: The Master fixes operation identity, Gen3-to-Gen5 direction, count, expected width/speed and no-error outcome. Exact vendor syntax, topology, capabilities, timing and recovery are runtime Project Configuration; a per-cycle Gen3-entry and Gen5-equalization ledger makes the review executable without inventing values.
decision_basis: XLSX row 2110, same-row DeepSeek columns, GPT V2, historical record, unique identity and ED-01 through ED-30 were reviewed; actual next formal row Functionality 2111 / Wistron-GB NV PVP HW-00032-V002 / 7cdd3117e04f1a69 was directly read from XLSX and manifest.
Speed Change 35 uniquely covers 500 Gen3-to-Gen5 transitions; Gen2-to-Gen5 and Gen4-to-Gen5 evidence cannot replace it.
Bind the approved LTSSM/NVQual action and immutable Gen5-capable root-port/switch/retimer/backplane/endpoint/GPU/lane path.
For each numbered cycle prove Gen3/full-width start before the Gen5 request, then record equalization/LTSSM, settle deadline, target speed/width, enumeration and new error/health deltas.
Count only complete durable entries and preserve the chronological 1..500 ledger; a final snapshot is insufficient.
Stop before the next cycle on invalid start, capability mismatch, failed/late/downtrained Gen5, endpoint/sibling loss, new disqualifying AER, reset, log gap or thermal/power anomaly.
Preserve baseline and first-fault evidence, never clear or automatically retry, and use only signed recovery.
No LTSSM/NVQual, speed change, retraining, PCIe query, recovery, retry or DUT operation was performed.

test_case.purpose: Prove the mapped GB-NV-PVP PCIe path completes five hundred genuine full-width Gen3-to-Gen5 transitions within the approved Gen5 equalization/settle envelope without disqualifying errors.
required_package: Pinned approved NVIDIA LTSSM/NVQual Speed Change 35 build, command and configuration
Immutable Gen5-capable PCIe hierarchy/lane map and expected width
Dedicated SUT, durable ledger/interlock, console, stable power/cooling and recovery
test_case.test_command: BLOCKED until Project Configuration is signed. Preserve link/topology/error/health baselines; after point approval execute only Speed Change 35 for entries 1..500. Prove Gen3/full width before each request; capture Gen5 request, equalization/LTSSM, settled speed/width, enumeration, error deltas and health before enabling the next entry. Stop on first invalid state, fault or artifact gap; do not clear or retry.
test_case.expected_result: All 500 entries independently prove full-width Gen3 start and Gen5 settle at required width within the signed envelope, with endpoint/siblings present, no disqualifying new PCIe/GPU/host/BMC/thermal/power error, and approved final health.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: No PASS until tool, path, Gen5 capability, Gen3-start method and limits are approved. PASS then requires 500 complete accepted Gen3-to-Gen5 records. FAIL on invalid start, unsupported/late/wrong/reduced target, device loss, disqualifying error/reset or recovery failure. Missing input/artifact is BLOCKED; replay cannot erase failure.
safety_gate: Gate CLOSED until tool/path, Gen3-start proof, Gen5 capability/target, equalization/error/deadline policy, interlock and recovery are approved.
Use an isolated SUT with console, stable power/cooling and point authorization.
Durably preserve every start, training/equalization and final state plus error evidence.
Stop without retry on first state, capability, link/device, error/evidence or safety anomaly.
expected_evidence: Exact row/variant/hash, Speed Change 35 tool/configuration and approval
Complete Gen5-capable path/lane map plus Gen3-start and Gen5 equalization/full-width/deadline/error contract
Ledger 1..500 with raw Gen3 start, request, LTSSM/equalization, settled Gen5/width, enumeration, timestamps and result
Per-cycle error/platform-health correlation and completeness audit
First-fault/recovery or clean final topology/health, no-retry audit and engineer verdict
test_case.recovery: On invalid Gen3 entry, unsupported or failed/late/downtrained Gen5, endpoint/sibling loss, disqualifying error/reset or artifact gap, inhibit later requests and preserve the first event. Do not substitute adjacent coverage or retry; follow signed recovery and quarantine if topology/health is not restored.
